Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

plan — an idea about what you will do. Example: My plan is to study next year.
past — the time before now. Example: I talk about my past.
future — the time after now. Example: In the future I want to travel.
milestone — an important event in life. Example: Finishing school is a milestone.
memory — something you remember. Example: My best memory is my first job.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I was born in ...
• I finished school in ...
• Next year I am going to ...
• My best memory is ...
• My plan is ...
